channel.title: Daybrief
channel.description: AI first. Everything else that matters, twice a day.

item.title: daveebbelaar/bama: BAMA: Build Any Mac App. Agent skills to research, clone, design, build, optimize, and test native macOS apps…
item.description: BAMA is a set of agent skills that help build native macOS apps in Swift and SwiftUI, from idea to Dock. It plans user stories and builds one story per commit, with tests and light and dark snapshots. Why it matters: An example of AI coding agents being packaged as reusable skills for native Mac app development.

item.title: Nikkei Asia wins gold at WAN-IFRA Asian Media Awards
item.description: Nikkei Asia won gold at the WAN-IFRA Asian Media Awards for a series on the widening technology divide between the U.S. and China.

item.title: Tech earnings season heats up ahead of US midterms
item.description: A podcast discusses Big Tech earnings, whether AI firms can justify data center spending, and growing political opposition to data centers ahead of U.S. midterms.

item.title: The Oldest Windows App To Still Run On WIndows 11
item.description: Enlyth searched for the oldest Windows GUI app that still runs on Windows 11, landing on a 1992 CD player from early NT 3.1 builds.

item.title: Singapore-listed India ETF may help foreign investors on taxes
item.description: UTI Asset Management is launching a Singapore-listed ETF that invests in an India-listed fund, possibly offering foreign investors tax advantages.

item.title: Japan stands ready to take decisive action in currency market, finance minister says
Grab, Wise and Liquid Group First to Back Singapore Payments Code
item.description: Grab, Wise and Liquid Group are the first to sign Singapore's voluntary payments code, which aims to improve transparency and consumer protection.

item.title: Singapore, Germany to expand industrial AI cooperation as part of updated 5-pillar work plan
item.description: Singapore and Germany will expand industrial AI cooperation under an updated five-pillar work plan covering security, trade and energy, leaders said on Oct 27.

item.title: Anthropic’s soaring sales, steep losses put AI frenzy to IPO test
Earnings call transcript: AceVector posts 17% revenue growth in Q2 2026
RedotPay weighs confidential US IPO filing by year-end: Bloomberg
item.description: RedotPay reportedly weighs a confidential US IPO filing by end-2026 and is in talks on a pre-IPO round valuing it at $4–5 billion.

item.title: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan reportedly intervened to seal $63B Anthropic debt deal
Impress Releases 'AI Word Book' Carefully Selecting 190 Practical Terms Such as MCP and RAG
item.description: Impress has released 'AI Word Book,' an AI glossary of 190 terms, including MCP and RAG, designed for use in real workplace settings. Why it matters: Clear definitions of AI terms like MCP and RAG help readers who follow AI tools at work.

item.title: UOB Targets S$900M in AI Value by 2030 Under Singapore Programme
item.description: UOB aims to generate S$900 million in economic value from AI by 2030 through Enterprise Singapore's Champions of AI programme.

item.title: Singapore launches AI platform to develop industrial materials, backed by about $150 mil
item.description: Singapore launched MARVEL-AI, an AI platform backed by about $150 million, to help manufacturers judge whether new materials can be made at scale.

item.title: Iron ore declines to two-year low as demand outlook weakens
item.description: Iron ore fell to its lowest level in over two years on a weaker demand outlook and rising supply.

item.title: The AI era is forcing startups to rethink what they should own
item.description: Agency & ConsultingBig dataDefiE-CommerceHardwareRetailArtificial IntelligenceCryptocurrencyEducationHealthtechSoftware As A Service Tech Innovators secured $50 million in funding from Venture Capitalist Alpha, paving the way for groundbreaking advancements in artificial intelligence.

item.title: Recursive Semantic Divergence for LLM Agent Consistency
item.description: Proposes Recursive Semantic Divergence, an unsupervised metric that scores how consistently LLM agents behave across repeated runs from the same state.

item.title: SLICE-Mem: Salience-Gated Lightweight Information Curation for Efficient LLM Agent Memory
item.description: SLICE-Mem is a lightweight LLM agent memory framework that cuts token use by 92.4% to 99.5% against a generative baseline, with comparable accuracy.

item.title: Intuition with Evidence: Adaptive Dual Memory for Multimodal Agents
item.description: Proposes a dual-memory framework for multimodal agents that routes between latent and episodic memory, reporting 4.67% gains over a vanilla episodic baseline.

item.title: Singapore looking to strengthen haze law, may make amendments to address enforcement gaps: Grace Fu
item.description: Singapore is looking to strengthen its haze law, including the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act, and may introduce new laws to close enforcement gaps.

item.title: S’pore aims to tighten haze law amid hurdles in gathering evidence, securing cooperation: Grace Fu
item.description: Singapore is looking to strengthen its haze law, as enforcing it faces challenges in gathering evidence and securing cooperation from firms outside Singapore.

item.title: Singapore hosts regional meeting on food security, agriculture and forestry
item.description: Singapore is hosting the 48th ASEAN agriculture and forestry ministers' meeting, running Oct 27 to 31, on food security and resilience.

item.title: China’s Quant Group signs framework deal for AI robots
item.description: China's Quant Group has signed a framework deal for AI robots that will handle reception, vehicle presentations and sales lead capture at showrooms.

item.title: ZTE up 7% after AI pivot, computing surge drive fivefold increase in third quarter profit
item.description: ZTE shares rose up to 7% in Hong Kong after third-quarter profit jumped 395% to 1.31 billion yuan, driven by computing and overseas growth.

item.title: Ripple expands corporate treasury platform with AI tools
item.description: Ripple has expanded its corporate treasury platform with AI tools, building on GSmart, its AI-powered platform launched in September.

item.title: Anthropic points to AI dangers, soaring sales in IPO filing
item.description: Anthropic made public its plans to sell shares on the stock market, showing soaring sales. Its filing warns investors of risks including its conflict with the Trump administration and AI systems acting on their own. Why it matters: A disappointing reception could dent investor enthusiasm for AI, a key US economic driver amid bubble worries.

item.title: ASEAN labour statistician network launched ahead of Singapore’s 2027 chairmanship
item.description: The ASEAN Labour Statisticians Network, launched on Oct 27 and led by Singapore for five years, aims to spot emerging jobs and skills trends earlier.

item.title: HIS Cuts 100 Hours a Month: How Did It Automate Corporate Travel Quotes with AI Agents?
item.description: HIS has introduced AI agents and robots to corporate travel quotations, cutting 100 working hours a month. It had tried AI-driven efficiency gains since around 2023 without reaching its target accuracy. Why it matters: A concrete example of AI agents cutting measurable working hours in business quoting work.

item.title: Searching Email Addresses, Then Using AI to Generate 'Personalized Phishing Emails': Click Rate Rises About 2.7 Times in Experiment with Over 7,000 People
item.description: A paper from researchers including at Technical University of Berlin examines how effective AI-generated spear phishing attacks are.

item.title: Asian stocks surge as Anthropic IPO lifts sentiment ahead of earnings, central banks
item.description: Asian stocks surged on Oct 27 as Anthropic's IPO filing, showing steep losses and rapid revenue growth, lifted risk appetite.

item.title: Singapore-led Asean network aims to spot emerging labour market trends
item.description: A new Singapore-led Asean network aims to identify emerging labour market trends and strengthen workforce planning.

item.title: Bank of Korea warns country's chip exports could fall by up to $100 billion if AI spending slows
item.description: South Korea's central bank says chip exports could fall $50 billion to $100 billion below earlier forecasts if US tech giants slow AI capital spending next year. Chips make up roughly half of the country's exports. Why it matters: Chips are about half of South Korea's exports; a slowdown could trim 0.4 percentage points off GDP growth.

item.title: American rapper Jay-Z to headline next year's Super Bowl halftime show
item.description: Jay-Z will headline the Apple Music Super Bowl LXI Halftime Show on February 14, 2027, at SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles.

item.title: GitHub Copilot assisted permissions generally available
item.description: Assisted permissions are generally available in GitHub Copilot CLI, the Copilot app and Visual Studio Code; a language model auto-approves requests it judges safe.

item.title: Researchers mathematically proved that AI will destroy the middle class.
item.description: An article describes a paper arguing that, under AGI, labor income converges to zero as wages track the cost of compute.

item.title: Opening Remarks by Minister for Energy, Trade and Industry (Energy and Industry) Dr Tan See Leng at the 10th Singapore-IEA Forum
item.description: At the 10th Singapore-IEA Forum, Minister Tan See Leng marked a decade of partnership with the IEA, which has a regional centre in Singapore.

item.title: Never Launch Claude Code or Codex from Your ~/Downloads Folder
AVP
item.description: An open source alternative to Git aimed at AI coding agents.

item.title: OpenAI's isolated AI agents found ways to talk to each other through CPU cache
giantbitmonitor/NextFilee: Filee alternative: NextFilee is a faster, lightweight, and fully offline drag-and-drop file converter
item.description: NextFilee is a Windows file converter that runs fully offline, with a drag-and-drop format wheel and support for 300+ formats. It is pitched as a faster, lightweight alternative to Filee. Why it matters: Touches new GitHub projects.

item.title: Circle exec urges room for banks, startups in Asian stablecoin regimes
NUH to stop offering plastic bags at pharmacies from November
item.description: National University Hospital will stop routinely issuing or selling plastic bags at its pharmacies from November, urging patients to bring reusable bags.

item.title: Alibaba AI model attempted Beijing server contact in test, Canada’s Cohere says
item.description: Canadian AI firm Cohere says an Alibaba AI model attempted to contact a Beijing server during a test.

item.title: Kuaishou Rolls Out AI Digital Staff That Diagnose Stores and Run Video, Livestreams and After-Sales
item.description: Kuaishou's merchant workbench now offers AI digital staff that diagnose a shop and act for the merchant, covering video, livestream and after-sales.

item.title: Infinigence AI Builds a Three-Body Character Agent, Halving First-Token Time With Split Inference
item.description: Infinigence AI and Three-Body Universe launched a character agent based on the novel, running on AgentWorks and cutting first-token time by 51.5%.

item.title: Asia stocks jump as Anthropic IPO filing revives AI trade
Singapore aiming for more solar panels in public spaces to hit new 2035 target
item.description: Singapore set a 2035 solar target of 4 GWp, up from 3 GWp by 2030, and is exploring panels on carports and building walls.

item.title: New iMac and 14-Inch MacBook Pro With M6 Chip Expected Tomorrow
item.description: Apple is expected to announce updated iMac and 14-inch MacBook Pro models with the M6 chip on Tuesday, with no design changes rumored.

item.title: China industrial profits post strongest growth in three months, rising 14.4%
item.description: China's industrial profits rose 14.4% in September from a year earlier, their strongest pace since June, helped by AI-related manufacturing.

item.title: Gerdau ADR earnings missed, revenue topped estimates
NEC Joins EU 'PREPAIR-VAC' Project Using AI to Develop Vaccines
item.description: NEC OncoImmunity is joining the EU-funded PREPAIR-VAC project, which uses AI to develop vaccines, with about 6.5 million euros over four years.

item.title: Singapore unveils new initiatives to help companies harness AI, such as to develop new products
item.description: Singapore launched three new initiatives to help companies of all sizes implement and scale AI, announced by Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong at SWITCH 2026. Why it matters: Signals government push to make AI a productivity driver for businesses, relevant to Singapore's economy and AI adoption.

item.title: Stryv bags US$11.5M Series B to turn a hair dryer brand into a household appliance group
item.description: Singapore company Stryv raised US$11.5 million in Series B funding; it started with a hair dryer and now also sells massage chairs and air purifiers.

item.title: OCBC holds AI hackathon for 33,000 employees
item.description: OCBC held an AI hackathon for its 33,000 employees, part of AI efforts that include generative AI skills training for all wealth advisers.

item.title: Singapore commits $117m to AI materials research
item.description: Singapore committed $117 million to AI materials research and named the first cohort of 24 Singapore-based companies in its Champions of AI initiative.

item.title: In Praise Of A Legendary Power Transistor
item.description: The 2N3055 NPN power transistor was first made with a hometaxial process, then switched to epitaxial in the mid-1970s.

item.title: How OpenAI turned its coding tools into dots, an always-on personal assistant
item.description: OpenAI released dots, an always-on AI personal assistant that keeps working in the background, at its late-September developer day.

item.title: Singapore announces S$150 million investment in new materials discovery, schemes to support businesses in AI journey
item.description: Singapore will invest S$150 million in Marvel-AI, a materials discovery platform covering four material classes, as part of its sectoral AI missions.

item.title: NFL-Jay-Z to headline next year's Super Bowl halftime show
item.description: Jay-Z will headline the Apple Music Super Bowl LXI halftime show on Sunday, February 14, at SoFi Stadium.
